PQ Leader Alleges Ottawa Interference in Quebec Election

Parti Québécois (PQ) leader Paul St-Pierre Plamondon has expressed concern that the federal government in Ottawa is interfering in the Quebec provincial election. Plamondon specifically accused Ottawa of meddling to benefit the Coalition Avenir Québec (CAQ). The reports do not detail specific actions taken by Ottawa or provide evidence for the interference claims.
